proratable.definition: a. Capable of being prorated, or divided proportionately.

prorate.definition:
v. make a proportional settlement or distribution
v. divide or assess proportionally
prorate.translation: v. 按比例分配, 按比例摊派

prorated.translation: v. 比例分配, 分派( prorate的过去式和过去分词 )

prorated joint rate.translation: [经] 按比例分摊联合运价

prorates.definition:
v make a proportional settlement or distribution
v divide or assess proportionally
prorates.translation: v. 比例分配, 分派( prorate的第三人称单数 )

prorating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Prorate
prorating.translation: v. 比例分配, 分派( prorate的现在分词 )

proration.definition: n the proportional limitation of production or distribution of something (e.g. crude oil or natural gas) to some fractional part of the total capacity of each producer

prore.definition: n. The prow or fore part of a ship.

prorhinal.definition: a. Situated in front of the nasal chambers.

prorogates.definition:
-s form of prorogate
v. t. To prorogue.
prorogates.translation: (prorogate 的第三人称 -s形式) n.休会

prorogation.definition: n. discontinuation of the meeting (of a legislative body) without dissolving it
prorogation.translation:
n. 休会
[法] 休会, 闭会, 法院扩大管辖权

prorogue.definition: v. adjourn by royal prerogative; without dissolving the legislative body
prorogue.translation:
vt.vi. (使)闭会, (使)休会
[法] 使休会, 使闭会

prorogued.translation: v. 使（议会）休会( prorogue的过去式和过去分词 )

prorogues.definition:
v hold back to a later time
v adjourn by royal prerogative; without dissolving the legislative body
prorogues.translation: v. 使（议会）休会( prorogue的第三人称单数 )

proroguing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Prorogue
proroguing.translation: v. 使（议会）休会( prorogue的现在分词 )

proruption.definition: n. The act or state of bursting forth; a bursting out.
proruption.translation: n. 隆起,突出, 膨胀
